header.caveat: Measured on a NON thermally steady machine: absolute ms/Mpx/s carry a +-30..70% spread between runs (docs/FSCRIPT_MEASUREMENTS.md §0-a saw 1.7x between a cold and a warm box). Trust the SAME-RUN relative numbers (ratio_vs_core) and the structure of the breakdown, not the absolute value. rss_peak_x is a ~0.4 ms polling thread and MISSES ops shorter than ~10 ms; tm_peak_x only sees numpy allocations, not C-internal buffers.
